relevance_note: Case report of a mother and daughter with a TNFAIP3 variant: "revealed a heterozygous NM_001270508.2: c.608T > G, p.(Leu203Arg) missense variant of TNFAIP3 in both patients".
method_note: Built with a short Python script from my own reading; every span checked verbatim by script. In scope: P1 (mother), P2 (daughter), the brother of P1 (affected relative described only in the Figure 1 legend; not tested, no variant row), and L001, a 'CVID patient control with TNFAIP3 LoF mutation c.1309del (p.Ala437Profs)' used as a laboratory control (individual-level facts: CVID, variant, A20/actin ratio); included because the scope covers every person described with a TNFAIP3 variant, but the paper does not give L001 an HA20 diagnosis. Left out: P1's TNFRSF13B c.310T > C (p.Cys104Arg), described as 'a known risk factor' present in 0.3%-0.5% of the population (risk allele rule), although the Discussion later says the evidence supports 'a causal relationship' and that it may contribute to IgA deficiency and autoimmunity in the mother. Table 1 P1 row is split across two Markdown lines inside the Igs cell, so spans for P1's Clinical presentation and Therapy cells cannot include the P1 label; those spans start at the cell. Inconsistencies: Table 1 gives age at onset 18 years for P1 but the text gives a childhood history of oral and genital ulcers; Table 1 gives 9 years for P2, the text says ulcers 'since adolescence'. Table onset recorded. Presentation ages (P1 49 years, P2 29 years) recorded as feature onset of the presenting events, not as last evaluation or diagnosis. CT angiography 'without features typical of vasculitis' recorded as excluded, but skin biopsy showed leucocytoclastic vasculitis and APS 'with both thrombosis and vasculitis' was diagnosed; checklist vasculitis kept observed because the CT finding concerns the iliac occlusion only (narrower). P2 inheritance 'inherited maternal': the variant is stated in both patients and P1 is P2's mother. Checklist judgement calls kept 'not reported': P1 leukopenia and pernicious anemia not called autoimmune cytopenia; P1 single bout of gastroenteritis with high fever (not recurrent, not stated inflammatory); P2 diarrhea; P2 'no signs of insulin deficiency' not taken to exclude type 1 diabetes; brother's 'rheumatism' and 'thyroid disease' too unspecific for arthritis or autoimmune thyroiditis. Normal C3/C4 recorded as excluded 'low complement' (D-27). 'Both patients'/'patient sera' statements applied to P1 and P2 as named-group statements. Variant fields for the TNFAIP3 variant come from sentences naming both patients or this exact variant (functional data: patient PBMCs and HEK293T expression of this variant). L001 variant type left 'not reported' (only 'LoF' printed).

functional_evidence_statement.value: reduced A20 expression in patient-derived PBMCs before and after TNFα stimulation (A20/actin ratio after TNFα: P1 0.205, P2 0.218 vs HC mean 0.802); in transfected HEK293T cells mutant A20 expression reduced with increased TRAF6 and phosphorylated IκBα after TNFα stimulation
span: showed reduced A20 expression in patient-derived PBMCs, both before and after TNFα stimulation (Fig. 2A)
(P1: 0.205; P2 0.218; L001 0.453 versus mean ratio HC:0.802, see Supplementary Table 1)
In this model, mutant A20 expression was consistently reduced, while levels of TRAF6 and, to a lesser extent, phosphorylated IκBα were increased following TNFα stimulation (Fig. 2B).
We demonstrated that this mutation results in an altered protein with reduced A20 expression in both patient-derived cells and an ectopic expression model.
